description:
SWE-CoWork Bench
	

SWE-CoWork is a benchmark for coding agents that have to work like a new team member: in a real repository, over many hours, with requirements spread across teammates instead of written down in one specification.
Each task places the agent in a simulated workplace. It sees a project board, design documents, code reviews, artifacts and a team chat. Most requirements are held by LLM-simulated colleagues, and an agent only gets them by asking the right person the… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tokenwave-AI/swe-cowork.
